18.prompt: Create an English incident handover from fixtures/incident.csv. Summarize the timeline, impact, root cause, recovery and two follow-up actions. Use the installed document skill and read its instructions before creating the document. Save a two-page document as handover outputs/incident brief.docx and its PDF as handover outputs/incident brief.pdf. Give me both files so I can open them. Do not upload anything or use the network.

criteria.task_content: accurate timeline, 12 affected synthetic users, omitted expiry root cause, recovery and two concrete follow-up actions
criteria.skill_use: read applicable document skill before document creation
criteria.file_integrity: valid DOCX and PDF with two pages; retain generated hashes separately
criteria.reference_syntax: exact absolute Markdown targets, spaces enclosed by angle brackets
criteria.visible_preview: operator opens both intended files and confirms previews and obvious layout issues
